question: Which of the following about Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) of India is NOT true?

options.text: It was recommended by the Amitabh Kundu Committee.
It was used by the Indian armed force exclusively.
It was launched by the National Statistical Office.
It was India’s first computer-based survey.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It was used by the Indian armed force exclusively.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Considering the importance of the availability of labour force data at more frequent time intervals, the **NSO** launched the **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)** in April **2017.**
 
• The **First report of the PLFS was published in June 2019 for the period of 2017-18.** It was India’s first computer-based survey. 
 
• The **second annual report is being brought out by NSO on the Basis of the periodic Labour force Survey conducted during 2018-19.**
 
• The present Quarterly Bulletin is the **fifteenth in the series for the quarter of April – June 2022.**
 
• The** Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) was recommended by the Amitabh Kundu Committee.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** National Statistical Office (NSO)**

 
• On **23rd May 2019**, the Indian government passed the order to merge the **NSSO** with the Central Statistics Office (**CSO**) to form the **National Statistical Office (NSO).**
 
• NSO was first envisaged by **Rangarajan Commission** to implement and maintain statistical standards and coordinate statistical activities of Central and State agencies as laid down by the** National Statistical Commission (NSC).**
 
• NSSO is responsible for the conduct of large-scale sample surveys in diverse fields on an all-India basis.
 
• **Parent Ministry**: It is the statistical wing of the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).**
